sources.title: GitHub - mx4ai/qwen2.5: Qwen2.5 is the large language model series ...
sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.

sources.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: For smaller models, we observe that the Qwen2.5-0.5B model achieves performance that is on par with or even surpasses the Qwen2-1.5B model. This indicates that the Qwen2.5 series has optimized parameter usage, enabling mid-sized models to achieve similar performance levels to larger models from the previous generation.

sources.title: QwenLM/Qwen2.5 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen2.5 represents the latest generation in the Qwen language model series, released in September 2024. It consists of dense, decoder-only language models designed for a wide range of natural language processing tasks, including text generation, conversation, tool use, and role-playing.
